shots.intent: 详情页首屏一眼给出「一面墙定全屋」的核心主张，用全高实景墙与沙发尺度锚住买家停留。
shots.textZone: 顶部留白两行标题「{selling_point_1}」，其下短强调线 #2F5A4A 与两枚 1px 描边胶囊「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 用同一面墙的三处构造引线，一秒讲清整墙定制的工艺卖点。
shots.textZone: 顶部标题「{selling_point_1}」，右侧纵向三枚 1px 描边胶囊「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，细引线指向顶缝、拼缝与柜底收口

shots.intent: 放大裂缝、补丁底灰、线管外露与阴角不直这些真实墙面痛点，制造解决需求。
shots.textZone: 左上一枚 1px 描边胶囊「{callout_1}」，右下一枚描边胶囊「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 同墙同机位双栏对照，让买家肉眼比出现场漆墙与整装墙板的差别。
shots.textZone: 两栏各一枚顶部标题条「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，中央竖向石墨标签条 #3D4249 上写「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 以岩纹大板背景墙加悬浮柜的真实客厅场景，让买家把自己家套进来。
shots.textZone: 底部一枚 1px 描边胶囊「{callout_1}」，引线指向大板拼缝

shots.intent: 把同一套墙板推进卧室床头场景，证明全屋同系统可延展。
shots.textZone: 顶部两行标题「{selling_point_1}」，右下两枚描边胶囊「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 微距证明线脚轮廓与拼缝做工，打消收边粗糙的疑虑。
shots.textZone: 底部一枚描边胶囊「{callout_1}」，引线指向拼缝

shots.intent: 仰视放大全高墙体与顶面收口，讲清到顶一体感与灯槽关系。
shots.textZone: 顶部一枚描边胶囊「{callout_1}」，引线指向顶缝；底部一行小标签「{callout_2}」指向踢脚收口

shots.intent: 俯视平铺三种版型与收边件，回答我家墙面该选哪一种。
shots.textZone: 每块样板旁一枚细线标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，右侧两枚胶囊「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」

shots.intent: 宫格给出一墙六色的风格选项，让买家自行对号入座完成选款。
shots.textZone: 每格底部一枚规格标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_6}」，顶部一行标题「{selling_point_1}」

shots.intent: 以可核验的服务节点消除大额定制交易的决策风险。
shots.textZone: 石墨带内标题「{selling_point_1}」，五个节点标签「{callout_1}」至「{callout_5}」，三段付款块「{callout_6}」「{callout_7}」「{callout_8}」

shots.intent: 收口引导买家提交墙面尺寸并发起量房咨询。
shots.textZone: 顶部两行标题「{selling_point_1}」，底部 1px 描边矩形按钮「{callout_1}」，按钮上方一行小字「{callout_2}」

style.backgroundSystem: 两套背景严格交替：雾白实景墙 #F5F4F1（始终含踢脚与顶面阴影缝，见得到墙的全高）与平面浅石灰信息底板 #E4E2DC；石墨带 #3D4249 只允许用于标题条与流程时间轴，禁止随机换景、禁止户外与纯色渐变背景
style.iconSystem: 1.2 单位细线单色图标 #3D4249，方切端点，配 1px 描边胶囊标签；禁止填充色块图标、禁止等轴测插画、禁止立体徽章
style.lightingSystem: 单一大型漫射 5000K 正面日光，墙面自上而下渐进衰减，无方向性日光带、无暖光滤镜；仅微距与剖切镜头允许加一道低角度 5000K 掠光揭示线脚凹凸；接触阴影必须真实存在，所有竖线与拼缝保持真正垂直
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium architectural whole-home wall-paneling ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist-white room-build wall #F5F4F1, flat pale limestone info board #E4E2DC, graphite type and band #3D4249, oat panel body #CFC5B4 and one accent pine green #2F5A4A; neutral tone throughout with no warm filters and no colour casts; background system alternates only the mist-white full-height room-build wall #F5F4F1 and the flat pale limestone board #E4E2DC, with the graphite band #3D4249 reserved for headline strips and the process timeline; lighting system is one large soft diffused 5000K frontal daylight source with a gentle top-to-bottom falloff, no directional sun band, one low raking 5000K fill allowed only on macro and section screens, honest contact shadows, corrected verticals and true 90-degree corners; surface system is matte putty-white panel body #D9D2C6 with frame mouldings #E6E1D8, sage stone-look slab #8E958C, fluted oat panel #CFC5B4, fabric insert board #B9C0B4 and pale grey metal trim #A9A6A0 over a limestone floor #DDD9D2; typography is one modern geometric sans-serif family used only at light and regular weights with wide letter spacing, two-line headline, one hairline accent rule in #2F5A4A and 1px outlined pill tags; layout system uses sharp right-angle frames, hairline leader lines and small numbered circles, never rounded frosted cards; icon system is 1.2-unit hairline single-line icons in #3D4249 with square-cut ends, no filled icons, no isometric illustration; panelling is always shown full height from floor to ceiling shadow-gap with panel rhythm, moulding profile, joint reveals and insert material held constant across the set, every scene anchored by a real furnishing for scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks, no invented material grades or dimensions.
noDrift: no brand marks or supplier names
no invented board grades, thickness, dimensions, certifications or price figures

palette.name: 石墨文字与信息带（基础）

style.presentationRules: 护墙板永远以全高呈现（地面到顶面阴影缝），版型节奏、框线线脚轮廓、拼缝开槽宽度与夹芯材质在整套内保持一致；实景镜头必须有真实家具（沙发/床/悬浮柜）作为尺度锚点，透视竖线校正；电视与柜体不得遮挡主拼缝；人物若出现只允许裁切的匿名局部，永不露脸
style.surfaceSystem: 墙板主体哑光灰泥白 #D9D2C6 配框线 #E6E1D8、鼠尾草岩纹大板 #8E958C、竖向格栅燕麦板 #CFC5B4、织物夹芯板 #B9C0B4、浅灰金属收边条 #A9A6A0，地面为哑光石灰石 #DDD9D2，信息画面为平整浅石灰板 #E4E2DC
style.typography: 现代几何无衬线中文单一家族，只用 light 与 regular 字重并加宽字距；标题两行制，下方一道松绿细强调线 #2F5A4A；标签 12-14 单位，所有画面内文字一律以占位符呈现，禁止复刻源文案
